summary: Hancock Park Corporate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 2 to its Note Purchase Agreement and termination of its Dealer Manager Agreement in connection with a Plan of Sale and Dissolution. The amendment modifies terms including financial reporting, change of control, and asset coverage to facilitate liquidation-basis accounting. The company terminated its continuous common stock offering. The filing does not constitute a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign but rather a prelude to dissolution. The specific terms of the plan are referenced under Item 8.01. Watch for subsequent filings detailing the liquidation process and asset sales.
